title: Fit-only SPLINE closed/periodic flag preservation
scope: Extend the existing fit-only SPLINE regression to cover closed and periodic group-70 flag preservation
Keep the evidence limited to source tag, parsed model, emitted tag, output reparse, fit-point transport, and following-record alignment
Use temporary controls in the existing test owner without a committed drawing fixture, CTest registration, or dependency

assertions: literal input group 70 is preserved in the imported DRW_Spline::flags
writer output contains exactly one group 70 with the original flag value
writer output reparses with the same flags, degree, fit points, and no control/knot/weight arrays
following LINE identity and coordinates remain aligned after both the source SPLINE and output SPLINE

validation.focusedSelectorResult: PASS (three flag cases in ASCII and Binary DXF)

evidenceLimits: The generated literals establish only group-70 tag/model/output transport for these three values.
No independent curve evaluator or normative interpolation algorithm was used; closed/periodic geometry equivalence is not established.
No DWG parser, peer executable, or native CAD application was exercised.
Temporary files are generated from scratch and removed after a passing run; no external drawing fixture was used.
